Quick take after reviewing MAP & license draft:

1) Credit ask — approve as invoice offset, 60–90 day expiry is fine. Recommend we ask for 90 days with a clause that unused credit converts to a one-time service credit applied only against contracted committed spend. Legal to confirm language.

2) Discount tiers — I support the stepped discounts, but propose slightly adjusted numbers to protect unit economics: 6% at >=3M, 10% at >=5M. Also suggest a minimum committed monthly baseline of 2M for the initial term to prevent very low usage under the commitment.

3) Approval flow — I will draft a one-page pricing brief for Sean (and Kimberly) that documents the financial impact and expected margin at each tier. Target: send to Kimberly by EOD today, then Sean to sign off tomorrow morning.
